title: Hearty Juicy Saudi Arabian Gouda Tagine
description: A resinous and juicy Saudi Arabian dish featuring Gouda cheese, perfect for a date night, this low-calorie-friendly tagine is a unique blend of flavors and textures, with the sweetness of dates and candies balanced by the savory cheese.
instructions: Preheat the oven to 375 degrees Fahrenheit.
Heat the olive oil in a large Dutch oven over medium heat.
Add the diced onion and cook until softened, about 5 minutes.
Add the minced garlic and grated ginger and cook for 1 minute.
Add the ground cumin, smoked paprika, salt, and black pepper, and cook for 1 minute.
Stir in the chopped dates and crushed candies.
Add the shredded Gouda cheese and stir until melted and well combined.
Transfer the Dutch oven to the preheated oven and bake for 20 minutes.
Remove from the oven and let cool for a few minutes before serving.
